evals.prompt: I'm picking envsetup back up. Where are we, and what should I do first?
evals.expected_output: A brief (under 1,600 characters) in the skill's template — released version, unreleased on main, parked branches, open/unverified items, the proposed next item and its first step, a 'read in full:' line — and a new docs/sessions/SES-NNN file with its Goal set; nothing else on disk changed except the regenerated sessions index.
expectations: brief.md is under 1,600 characters (wc -c) and states the released version v0.1.9
brief.md names what is on main but unreleased and the parked branch wip/visual-grouping

brief.md contains a line starting with 'read in full:' that names docs/OVERVIEW.md, CONTEXT.md and the newest SES file, and transcript.md shows each of those was read to its last line (a second read with offset where the tool truncated)
session-file.md exists: exactly one new docs/sessions/SES-NNN file was created and its Goal line is filled

git-state.txt shows HEAD unchanged from the fixture tip and nothing modified under docs/sessions/ other than the new file and README.md (the regenerated index) — in particular SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched
brief.md reports the state of the tree and the gate as findings (branch name; `bun run session -- --check` result) rather than fixing anything, and proposes a concrete next item with a first step
transcript.md shows no push, no PR, no commit

evals.prompt: I just committed the fix for the stale set-favorites.swift asset (it now matches the embedded constant). Record it properly before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: A docs(session) commit on HEAD whose entry for the fix commit has Summary, Why, a specific phrase per touched file (naming --list / LSSharedFileListItemCopyResolvedURL for the Swift file) and Notes saying how the claim was verified; OVERVIEW Next-up 5 and the two finder docs that called the asset stale updated; `bun run session -- --check` prints session: complete; SES-005 untouched.
expectations: commit.diff shows HEAD is a commit whose subject starts with docs(session): and the fix(finder) commit is an ancestor

session-file.md holds an entry for the fix(finder) commit whose src/items/finder/assets/set-favorites.swift line mentions --list or LSSharedFileListItemCopyResolvedURL (a specific phrase, not 'updated')
session-file.md's entry Notes state how the fix's claim was verified (a driver run, a byte comparison or swiftc), and transcript.md shows that verification command was actually run
git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
overview.diff shows docs/OVERVIEW.md Next-up 5 no longer lists the stale set-favorites.swift asset (removed or marked done, citing the fix commit)
commit.diff shows src/items/finder/CLAUDE.md and src/items/finder/.claude/skills/run-src-items-finder/SKILL.md no longer say the asset is stale
commit.diff does not touch docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md, and transcript.md shows files were staged by name (no `git add -A` / `git add .`)

evals.prompt: That's it for today, I'm done. Close things out.
evals.expected_output: The current session's Outcome and Open at end written, OVERVIEW Status/Next up checked (changed only if reality changed), a clean tree on main or every exception named, SES-005 untouched, and a closing note of at most 60 words: what shipped and the first thing to do next time.
expectations: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written (no _(fill in)_ on either line) and its Narrative mentions this closing
git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
reply.md is at most 60 words and states what shipped in the conversation and the first thing to do next time
overview.diff is 'no change', or changes only Status/Next up with a reason in transcript.md grounded in this conversation's own work (not in fixture scaffolding commits)
docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched (git-state.txt / commit shows no change to it) and no second session file was created
transcript.md shows no push, no PR opened, no merge
